title: Revisiting the Supermassive Black Hole Mass of NGC 7052 Using High Spatial Resolution Molecular Gas Observed with ALMA
question: What is the SMBH mass and stellar I-band M/L of NGC 7052 from 12CO(2-1) kinematics at 0.3 arcsec resolution, with an improved stellar plus molecular gas mass model?

data.sensitivity: 79 uJy/beam continuum; 0.5 mJy/beam per 10 km/s CO

evidence.quote: Given a distance of $D=69.3$ Mpc to NGC 7052 (cite: Ma14)
The galaxy has a stellar velocity dispersion at the effective radius of $\sigma_e = 266 \pm 13$ km s$^{-1}$

what.value: Previous MBH (2.5±0.3)e9 Msun from higher-resolution ALMA

evidence.quote: yielded a refined $M_{\rm BH}$ $=(2.5\pm0.3)\times10^9$ M$_{\odot}$ (cite: Smith21)

recipe.method: tclean Briggs robust 0.5; continuum MFS from continuum SPWs and line-free channels; uvcontsub then 10 km/s cube
masked moment method with smoothed-cube mask, threshold 0.5 sigma in unsmoothed cube
M_gas from integrated CO flux 45 Jy km/s with XCO
PSF (TinyTim) deconvolved, masked MGE fit of WFC F814W sky-subtracted image
assumptions: constant M/L, no dark matter in the center

recipe.method: two single-Gaussian MGE fits to the CO mass map (one per peak), fixed in the mass model

recipe.goal: Dynamical model fit of MBH and M/L
recipe.method: KinMS forward-model of the 3D cube; gas distribution from SkySampler or two Gaussians; circular velocity from mge_circular_velocity; 9 free parameters
key_parameters: 10^5 MCMC iterations, 20% burn-in; log-scale MBH; chi2 uncertainties rescaled by (2N)^0.25 with N=76,014
assumptions: circular orbits, thin disc, constant velocity dispersion, D = 69.3 Mpc

recipe.method: vary distance, disk thickness, dispersion profile, MGE masking, M/L(r) profiles

evidence.quote: the total molecular gas mass is estimated to be $M_{\rm gas} \approx 2.2 \times 10^9$ M$_{\odot}$
corresponding to a reduced chi-squared of $\chi^2_{\rm red, min} = 0.867$

not_stated_but_needed: Self-calibration solution intervals and number of rounds
Cleaning niter/threshold details and exact tclean parameters
Rest-frame velocity convention details and exact cube channel start
Exact MGE fit settings and masks
SkySampler/KinMS settings beyond those given (e.g. initial guesses)
The continuum flux in text (29.1 mJy) differs from Table 1 (24.9 mJy)
missing_for_reproduction: Archive vs. own-reduced data not clear
score_reason: Public data and fairly complete modelling description with software named and tables of fits, but some imaging and self-cal details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, forward-model recipe largely described, numeric MBH and M/L results.
